rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides programmatic access to the Omilia Cloud Platform (OCP), a conversational AI platform for managing voice applications and dialog systems. Built by Omilia using Python with FastMCP and comprehensive authentication handling, it offers 16 specialized tools including miniapp search and prompt management, orchestrator app canvas retrieval, dialog log analysis with advanced filtering, phone number integration, and environment variable collection management. The implementation features OAuth-based authentication with automatic token refresh, multi-environment support with URL mapping for analytics endpoints, structured JSON responses with detailed metadata, and robust error handling across all API interactions, making it valuable for conversational AI developers managing voice applications, customer service automation workflows, dialog system optimization, and building AI assistants that need deep integration with Omilia's platform for analyzing conversation flows and managing voice application configurations.
